content.description:
What Cognite is Relentless to Achieve

Cognite operates at the forefront of industrial digitalization, building AI and data solutions that solve the world’s hardest, highest-impact problems. Our Moonshot is bold: unlock $100B in customer value by 2035, and redefine how global industry works.

How you’ll demonstrate Ownership

We’re looking for an Integrated Marketing Manager to design, orchestrate, and measure account-based campaigns that turn our highest-value target accounts into pipeline. You’ll connect channels like content, digital, direct mail, and ABM programs into cohesive buyer journeys that move decision-makers through the buying journey.

What You’ll Do

Own account-based programs: Develop and run ABM programs for named accounts and priority industries across the full lifecycle.

Orchestrate integrated campaigns: Build multi-channel campaigns spanning email, paid social, webinars, and direct mail that engage buying groups in industrial enterprises.

Partner with GTM: Align with Sales, Marketing, and BDR on account lists, campaign plays, and coordinated outreach.

Personalize with data: Use firmographic, intent, and behavioral data to tailor outreach by industry, persona, and account stage, and to prioritize where we invest.

Maintain message consistency: Ensure positioning across all touchpoints reflects our narrative and stays consistent across campaigns.

Measure and optimize: Track account engagement, pipeline influence, and velocity. Run post-campaign analysis and keep testing and refining.

The Impact you bring to Cognite

What You’ll Bring

Bachelor’s degree and 3+ years of experience in ABM, integrated marketing, demand generation, or field/campaign marketing, ideally in B2B enterprise software

Proven success building and running account-based campaigns that drove measurable engagement, pipeline, and revenue

Experience using account data, segmentation, intent signals, and behavioral insights to shape strategy

Strong project management skills, including running multiple multi-channel programs and managing stakeholders at once

Analytical rigor, with comfort in attribution, funnel metrics, and data-driven optimization

Ability to turn complex technical topics into clear, compelling messaging for target audiences

Collaborative, self-directed, and comfortable with ambiguity in a fast-moving environment

Nice to Have

Marketing to industrial, energy, manufacturing, or other asset-heavy sectors

Experience marketing AI, data, or platform products to both technical and executive buyers

Hands-on experience with ABM and intent platforms (e.g., Zoominfo, 6sense, Demandbase, RollWorks), Salesforce, and marketing automation (e.g., HubSpot, Marketo, Pardot)

Experience supporting global and multi-region campaigns

A snapshot of our many perks and benefits as a Cogniter

Competitive compensation

401(k) with employer matching

Competitive health, dental, vision & disability coverages for employees and all dependents

Unlimited PTO

Paid Parental Leave Program

Employee Referral Program

Why Cognite

You will work at the forefront of Industrial AI, partnering with some of the world's leading industrial organisations to solve problems that actually matter at scale — not hypothetical ones. You'll join a collaborative, fast-moving environment where curiosity and ownership are the norm, not the exception. If you want delivery work you can point to and be proud of, we'd love to hear from you.

Equal Opportunity

Cognite is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment at work and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive the same level of consideration for employment.
